title: CSCI 509 — Seminar in Computer Science
subject: Computing Practice and Research
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the scope and flexibility of CSCI-509 as a faculty-piloted general Computer Science elective.
Explain the ACM Code of Ethics principles that guide responsible computing practice.
Describe the core components of responsible technical communication in computer science research.
